summary: Dependency-confusion beacon exfiltrates host identifiers to hardcoded VPS on install
details: Package ships a postinstall script (beacon.cjs) and a top-level require side effect (index.js) that POST installer-identifying data — os.hostname(), __dirname install path, process.cwd(), and process.version — to the hardcoded endpoint https://vmi3699893.contaboserver.net:8787/_ah/dc with TLS certificate verification disabled (rejectUnauthorized: false). The beacon fires automatically on `npm install` and again when the module is required. The package's main export is a no-op Proxy and the metadata describes it only as a 'Compatibility shim', so the beacon is the package's sole functional behavior. The `@c1-ease/autoloan` scope-plus-generic-name shape is consistent with a dependency-confusion probe against a private internal package name, with the beacon serving to confirm successful name resolution inside victim build systems.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
